# Lucille Lortel Award for Outstanding Body of Work

| location = United States
| holder = New Federal Theatre, (2025)
| website =
}}
The Lucille Lortel Award for Outstanding Body of Work is a special award presented annually at the Lucille Lortel Awards to honor an individual or organization for excellence in Off-Broadway theatre.
